compiled_state.description:
# Land dependabot PRs #129 + #130 as ONE Gerrit change (setup-uv v10 + uv-lock botocore/json-repair)

## Context / Problem

GitHub is a read-only mirror: dependabot PRs never merge there; content is
re-applied locally and landed via Gerrit, then the PRs are commented/closed.
Per operator directive these two open dependabot PRs are grouped into a SINGLE
ticket and a SINGLE Gerrit change (one commit touching both the CI-action pin
and the lockfile — the shared "dependency housekeeping" lane):

* PR #129 (`dependabot/github_actions/github-actions-fa3bf1173d`, github-actions
  group): `astral-sh/setup-uv` v9.0.0 (`c771a70e…`) -> v10.0.0 (`ae62891f…`),
  19 pinned-SHA references across 11 workflow files. VALIDITY: v10 is a major
  bump; its ONLY breaking change disables the cache for `enable-cache: auto` on
  `pull_request_target` / `workflow_run` / `release` events (cache-poisoning
  hardening, astral-sh/setup-uv#984). EVERY rebar usage passes
  `enable-cache: true` explicitly (never `auto`), so that change does not alter
  our behavior; the `version`/`version-file` additions are opt-in and unused.
  Dependabot pins the exact v10.0.0 commit SHA, so the bump is reproducible.

* PR #130 (`dependabot/uv/uv-lock-434831ba27`, uv-lock group): two lock-only
  patch bumps —
  - `botocore` 1.43.69 -> 1.43.70 (patch) — SAFE. Routine service-model update;
    consumed via lazy imports only (`bedrock_model.py`, `structured.py`,
    `remote_cert.py`). pyproject floor `botocore>=1.43.0` already admits it and
    boto3's botocore range (`<1.44`) accepts it, so boto3 need not move.
  - `json-repair` 0.63.0 -> 0.63.1 (patch) — SAFE. `src/rebar/llm/structured.py`
    calls `repair_json(cand, return_objects=True[, schema=…])`; the called API is
    unchanged across the patch. Floor `json-repair>=0.61` already admits it.
  The PR also carries uv's lockfile-format churn: `revision = 2 -> 3` and an
  httpcore2 marker simplification (dependabot ran a newer uv). Both are
  format/resolver byproducts, not dependency changes; `uv lock --check` on main
  already passes latest-uv, so revision is not load-bearing — but we reproduce
  the PR faithfully by regenerating with a recent uv.

## Approach

In a fresh worktree branched from `origin/main` (venv on PATH):

1. NO pyproject.toml edit — all bumps are admitted by existing constraints
   (setup-uv is a SHA pin in workflow YAML, not a pyproject dep; botocore /
   json-repair floors listed above; no exact pins exist for either).
2. setup-uv: replace every `astral-sh/setup-uv@c771a70e…  # v9.0.0` with
   `astral-sh/setup-uv@ae62891fec2bb8e7d6c99fc78c9fec3a63790f8d  # v10.0.0`
   across the 11 workflow files (19 sites) via an exact-string sed; verify 0
   remaining v9 SHAs and 19 v10 SHAs.
3. uv-lock: install a recent uv in the worktree, then
   `uv lock --upgrade-package botocore --upgrade-package json-repair`. If uv
   resolves PAST the PR's reviewed versions (per the #128 precedent it did),
   re-lock with exact `==1.43.70` / `==0.63.1` pins so the landed lock matches
   the certified scope; the newer patches arrive in the next dependabot round.
   Then `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra agents` so gates run against the
   bumped tree. Verify `git diff uv.lock` moved only botocore/json-repair (plus
   uv's transitive/format bookkeeping) — no other version churn.
4. Gates: YAML-parse the 11 changed workflow files; `uv lock --check`;
   `make lint`; `make typecheck`; targeted usage-surface tests
   (`pytest tests/unit/test_structured.py tests/unit/test_silent_success.py`
   for json-repair; `tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py` for the botocore lazy
   import — run whichever exist). Full `pytest tests/unit` is CI's job; CI
   Verified +1 is the authoritative full-suite gate.
5. ONE commit (subject <=50 chars, body wrapped at 72) with trailer
   `rebar-ticket: <this ticket's full canonical id>` + DCO `-s`;
   `git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main`. Leave the ticket in_progress for the
   bots; the change is submitted only after LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.
6. Comment on BOTH PR #129 and PR #130 pointing at the single Gerrit change and
   noting they were grouped; leave the PRs open for dependabot/operator to close
   once the mirror updates.

## STOP / defer rule (explicit fallback done-state)

If a package bump fails its targeted tests or lint/typecheck in step 4: drop
ONLY that package (re-lock from a clean `git checkout uv.lock` with the
remaining package), record the failure evidence as a ticket comment, and land
the remaining safe content. If setup-uv v10 fails a workflow-parse or a real
usage incompatibility surfaces, drop the actions bump and land the lock subset
(or vice-versa) — the two halves are independent. The fallback done-state:
the ticket closes legitimately with the landed subset, provided every dropped
item has a recorded-on-ticket failure reason.

## Out of scope

* Any src/rebar or test code change — nothing in these deltas requires one.
* boto3 / mcp / any other dependency bump not in PR #129 or #130.
* pyproject.toml constraint edits and `.github/complexity-baseline.json`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: on the landed change, all 19 setup-uv references read the v10.0.0 SHA
  `ae62891fec2bb8e7d6c99fc78c9fec3a63790f8d` across the 11 workflow files, zero
  v9 SHAs remain, and all 11 changed workflow files still parse as valid YAML.
- [ ] AC2: `uv.lock` records botocore 1.43.70 and json-repair 0.63.1 (or a
  documented STOP-rule subset), pyproject.toml is unchanged, and
  `uv lock --check` exits 0.
- [ ] AC3: `make lint` + `make typecheck` exit 0 and the targeted usage-surface
  tests pass against the bumped tree.
- [ ] AC4: the change lands through Gerrit as a SINGLE change with a
  `rebar-ticket:` trailer for this ticket's full canonical id + DCO sign-off,
  after LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.
- [ ] AC5: both PR #129 and PR #130 carry a comment pointing at the single
  grouped Gerrit change; both left open for the mirror/dependabot to close.
- [ ] AC6 (fallback): every item dropped under the STOP rule has a ticket
  comment recording the concrete failure evidence and the re-lock excluding it
  (vacuously satisfied when everything lands).
compiled_state.title: Land dependabot PRs #129 + #130 as one Gerrit change (setup-uv v10 + uv-lock botocore/json-repair)
